messages.content: I’ll sell 100 MWh in HE21 and recharge in HE24—the best feasible spread in the posted DA prices. I’ll start with a matching physical schedule, then reassess at each watch as prices and notices arrive.
Evening RT prices have risen above the earlier levels. I’ll split the discharge between 19:00–20:00 and 20:00–21:00 to capture more of the evening window, while keeping the full recharge at 23:00.
